conclusion: Both SFT models show severe catastrophic forgetting compared to the GRPO-trained base model. The 100K SFT training degraded multiplication accuracy dramatically (k=3: 98.4% -> 40-51%, k=4: 95.6% -> 1-4%). The cipher model performed WORSE than the distilled model (40.2% vs 51.0% on k=3), providing no evidence that cipher-encoded CoT helps with computation. Neither model shows any OOD generalization (k=7, k=8 both at 0%).
